todo: Purpose: Reuse mast construction between Gasworks Hill and the Skyport while reserving each approach as a composed landmark.
Visual brief: Tapered riveted frame, braced feet, ringed mooring head and a restrained wind pennant; cross-braces and overlapping struts make the volume legible.
Implement after review: Claude selects the design, draws it, supplies exact anchors/collision and passes the library gate; no concept may ship.
Geometry: proposed authoring envelope 7x7 cells; one cell is 8 world px / 24 art px. This is not an asserted solid footprint; collision, foot and overhang await the drawing.
Scale: custom landscape-compressed landmark, no current density3 mast class; do not apply lamp scale to a mooring tower.
Rule proposal: the foundation, guy-anchor polygons and mooring approach cannot overlap the terminal apron, public route or another mast.
A mast drawing does not add an airship service or destination.
